name: ratiod-scam-analyzer
title: Ratio'd Scam Risk Analyzer MCP
description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool integration for real-time scam, phishing, homoglyph, and malicious URL detection.

tools.name: analyze_content
tools.description: Analyzes email text, messages, SMS, or URLs for phishing, brand impersonation, urgent financial manipulation, homoglyph spoofing, and promotional tags.

text.description: Raw body of the email or message to evaluate.

emailMeta.description: Envelope metadata including sender and subject.

tools.name: unmask_url
tools.description: Traces HTTP redirect chains to uncover final landing domains and identify cloaked phishing URLs.

url.description: Shortened or cloaked link to trace.

tools.name: check_health
tools.description: Returns operational status and active detection layers of the Ratio'd engine.
